h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Mumbai

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Mumbai

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Mumbai

c: Mumbai is our home market. Our factory in Vasai is about 33 km from the city, so we can dispatch to a Mumbai site quickly and send our own installation team. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Mumbai for cooperative housing societies, builders, schools, colleges, corporate campuses and the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation's gardens and promenades.

Space shapes almost every Mumbai project. Societies often have only a podium, a terrace or a narrow strip along the compound wall. The city's promenades and gardens, from Marine Drive to Carter Road, see walkers from five in the morning. Salt air and a heavy monsoon from June to September are the other constants. Every frame we make is galvanised, and machines near the sea need a fresh-water rinse every few weeks.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 33 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: How quickly can you install an outdoor gym in Mumbai?
items.a: Our factory is close to the city, so dispatch is a short trip once the machines are made. Our sales team confirms the installation date after you approve the layout and quote.

items.q: Can outdoor gym equipment be fixed on a terrace or podium?
items.a: Often, yes, by the self-standing method on a firm slab. Your structural engineer should confirm the slab can take the load. We then mark each machine and its clear space on the drawing.

items.q: Will the machines rust near the sea?
items.a: The frames are galvanised, which resists corrosion in salt air. Rinse machines near the shore with fresh water every few weeks and check the bolts during routine maintenance.
